title: Find the district name (A3) with the highest total transaction amount in 19
question: Find the district name (A3) with the highest total transaction amount in 1997 among accounts linked to clients who hold a 'junior' card issued on or after January 1, 1997.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_018"
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_047"
INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN card AS T5 ON T4."XCL_013" = T5."XCL_006"
INNER JOIN client AS T6 ON T4."XCL_014" = T6."XCL_009"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_048") = '1997'
  AND T5."XCL_007" = 'junior'
  AND T5."XCL_008" >= '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY T2."XCL_018"
ORDER BY SUM(T3."XCL_051") DESC
LIMIT 1

eligibility_lowering.pre_lowering_sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_018"
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_047"
INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN card AS T5 ON T4."XCL_013" = T5."XCL_006"
INNER JOIN client AS T6 ON T4."XCL_014" = T6."XCL_009"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_048") = '1997'
  AND T5."XCL_007" = 'junior'
  AND T5."XCL_008" >= '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY T2."XCL_018"
ORDER BY SUM(T3."XCL_051") DESC
LIMIT 1
